createPoolAndLockLiquidity(address,uint2.details: The pool is created with a fee tier, that is stored in this contract. Call feeTier() to get the current value in scale of 10000 (e.g. 10000 = 1%). 1% is the maximum fee tier supported. Check the Uniswap V3 documentation for more details on fee tiers.This function can be called only by the bonding curve of the respective token.

params.amountToAdd: The amount of the token to add to the pool.
params.token: The address of the token to be added in the pair.

returns.amount0: The amount of the first token added to the pool.
returns.amount1: The amount of the second token added to the pool.
returns.liquidityDelta: The amount of liquidity added to the pool (See IUniswapV3Pool for more details).
returns.lockId: The UNCX ID of the lock created for the liquidity (See IUNCX_LiquidityLocker_UniV3 for more details).
returns.tokenId: The NFT ID of the created pool liquidity position.

getBondingCurveStorage().details: The BondingCurveStorage contract is a central contract that holds all the bonding curves and related data.

returns._0: The address of the BondingCurveStorage contract.

getFeeAccount().details: The FeeAccount contract is responsible for managing the fees collected from the Uniswap V3 pools and the bonding curves.

returns._0: The address of the FeeAccount contract.

getUncxLiquidityLocker().details: The UNCX liquidity locker contract is used to lock liquidity in Uniswap V3 pools. See IUNCX_LiquidityLocker_UniV3 for more details.

returns._0: The address of the liquidity locker contract.

getWeth().details: The WETH contract is used to wrap and unwrap Ether for liquidity operations.

getWethAddress().details: The WETH address is used to wrap and unwrap Ether for liquidity operations.

returns._0: The address of the WETH contract.

createPoolAndLockLiquidity(address,uint2.notice: Creates a new Uniswap V3 pool for the specified token (token/WETH pair) and token amount.
